# Subway Seat for Newsboat

Gold unread items, a raised bar for the cursor and the key hints, orange article headers and denim links. Newsboat can't take hex colors, so each file names the terminal-palette slots where that flavor's terminal port keeps these roles; use it with the same flavor in your terminal.

[Newsboat](https://newsboat.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/newsboat/) · Needs Newsboat 2.25+

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/newsboat/config (or ~/.newsboat/config if you use that folder):

```conf
include ~/.config/newsboat/subway-seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/newsboat/config (or ~/.newsboat/config if you use that folder):

```conf
include ~/.config/newsboat/subway-seat-tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/newsboat/config (or ~/.newsboat/config if you use that folder):

```conf
include ~/.config/newsboat/subway-seat-enamel
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/newsboat/config (or ~/.newsboat/config if you use that folder):

```conf

```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/newsboat/config (or ~/.newsboat/config if you use that folder):

```conf

```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/newsboat/config (or ~/.newsboat/config if you use that folder):


**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/newsboat/config (or ~/.newsboat/config if you use that folder):

```conf

```

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/newsboat/config (or ~/.newsboat/config if you use that folder):

```conf

```

**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.config/newsboat/config (or ~/.newsboat/config if you use that folder):


## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/newsboat/subway-seat`.
- Delete `~/.config/newsboat/subway-seat-tunnel`.
- Delete `~/.config/newsboat/subway-seat-enamel`.
- Delete `~/.config/newsboat/london-moquette`.
- Delete `~/.config/newsboat/london-deep-level`.
- Delete `~/.config/newsboat/london-portland`.
- Delete `~/.config/newsboat/paris-guimard`.
- Delete `~/.config/newsboat/paris-catacombes`.
- Delete `~/.config/newsboat/paris-carrelage`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
